this_court: Shaffer v. Heitner is limited to quasi in rem actions and does not extend to in rem civil forfeiture actions
quote: Thus, the dissent’s declaration of a circuit conflict is much exaggerated, particularly in view of the lack of any mention in Shaffer of overruling the legion of cases embodying principles of in rem jurisdiction.
cite: United States v. Tarek Obaid, 971 F.3d 1095 (9th Cir. 2020)
